html:
The Ugandan Bush War was a guerrilla war from 1981 to 1986 in which Yoweri Museveni's National Resistance Army fought the government of Milton Obote and then the generals who replaced him.

Museveni began with a small band attacking a barracks in February 1981 after a disputed election. The war centred on the Luwero Triangle north of Kampala, where government troops killed large numbers of civilians suspected of helping the rebels.

The rebels took Kampala in January 1986 and Museveni became president. Many of the fighters were Rwandan exiles, who later formed the core of the Rwandan Patriotic Front. The war followed the abuses of Obote's second government in Uganda.
sum: The Ugandan Bush War was a guerrilla war from 1981 to 1986 in which Yoweri Museveni's National Resistance Army fought the government of Milton Obote and then the generals who replaced him.
